summary: Gold Resource Corp filed an 8-K reporting supplemental disclosures to its proxy statement for a pending merger with Goldgroup Mining Inc., where Goldgroup's wholly owned subsidiary will merge into Gold Resource, leaving it as the surviving wholly owned subsidiary of Goldgroup. The per-share price and premium are not specified in this filing; the arrangement was originally announced on January 25, 2026, and amended on May 15, 2026. The board recommends the deal and has filed a definitive proxy statement. Multiple shareholder lawsuits threatened over disclosure adequacy; the company voluntarily supplements disclosures without admitting liability. The special meeting voting will involve approximately 163 million shares outstanding. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and potential litigation resolution.
